label: simulator defaults (uncalibrated), 14 Nov 2026; params sim/params/default.json; superseded by results/ (EdNet-calibrated)

criterion.decision_rule: per slot on the across-seed mean gain: >=15 pp supported, <5 pp rules adopted, otherwise inconclusive; H1 supported only if both slots are supported; rules adopted if both are <5 pp; else mixed/inconclusive

ednet.assumption: EdNet has no cheating labels. Flag rate is interpreted as realized FPR under the assumption that cheating is negligible in an ungraded self-study tutor (EdNet/Santa). This assumption is not verifiable from the data.
ednet.peer_feature_note: iforest and quantile_rules include peer features (synchrony/agreement within 5 s). EdNet learners do not sit a common timed quiz, so these features are not meaningful on EdNet; their rows are reported but flagged. quantile_rules_no_peers is a harness-constructed detector (frozen train.quantile_scores on BASE_FEATURES), not part of the frozen pipeline.
